translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content: A Pfumu, bila mbi telimini thama

content.text: Bila mbi ngeyo Yave telimini thama e ?
Bila mbi wididi wusuama mu thangu ziphasi e ?
Mu lunangu luandi, mutu wumbimbi
wulembo landakana mutu wulebakana ;
bobo babuilamanga mu makani momo kakubikidi.
Bila mutu wumbimbi wulembo kiniemisa mu nzinunu zi ntima andi ;
ayi wulembo sakumuna nkua lukokoto,
wulembo lenzi Yave.
Mu luniemo luandi, mutu wumbimbi kantombanga ko.
Mu mayindu mandi, Nzambi kasi kadi buangu ko.
Mu zithangu zioso, zinzila ziandi zidi zimboti
widi nkua lunangu
ayi mina miaku midi mitatuka kuidi niandi ;
wunsekininanga bambeni bandi zioso.
Wuniungutanga mu ntimꞌandi :
“Kuisi ko diambu dilenda ku ndikuna ;
Ndidi mu khini mu zithangu zioso ayi ndilendi ba mu phasi ko.”
Munu andi wuwedi tsingulu,
luvunu ayi buivi.
Ku tsi ludimi luandi kuidi ziphasi ayi mambimbi.
Wumfielanga mu ndambu mala.
Wumvondanga mutu kambulu zaba diambu mu bibuangu bisuama,
meso mandi manfielanga mu kinsueki bobo katidi vanga mbimbi.
Wumfielanga banga bumfiedilanga khosi bu kadi mu nsuku
wumfielanga mu diambu di buila batu bakambulu lusadusu.
Weti kuba kosikisa, bawu beti tumbu vonga ;
beti bua ku tsi zingolo ziandi.
Wuniungutanga mu ntimꞌandi :
“Nzambi zimbikini, fukidi zizi kiandi
ayi kalendi mona ko.”
A Yave Nzambi, telama, vumuna koko kuaku ;
kadi zimbakana batu bakambulu lusadusu !
Bila mbi mutu wumbimbi keti lenzila Nzambi e ?
Bila mbi kalembo niungutina mu ntimꞌandi :
“Kalendi tomba ko ti ndimvumbudila kipholo”
Muaki ngeyo Nzambi,
wulembo moni ziphasi ayi mabienga ;
Wulembo tadi mawu muingi wumatula va koko kuaku.
Nkua mabienga wukukiyekulanga kuidi ngeyo ;
ngeyo nsadisi wu muana sana.
Kelula koko ku mutu wumbimbi
ayi ku mutu weti vanga mambimbi,
nkambi kavumbudila kipholo mu mambimbi mandi ;
nate wela kambu buela ku mamona.
Yave niandi ntinu mu zithangu zioso
ayi mu thangu yi kayimani
Makanda mela bungana mu tsi andi.
A Yave, ngeyo weti wa zitsatu zi batu badi mu phasi.
Weti kuba kindisa ;
ayi dimba yamikina kuawu.
Mu diambu di nuanisa muana sana
ayi mutu weti yamusu muingi mutu widi va ntoto
kabika monisa tsisi.
